content:
zara: Ok team — we're doing a compact bring-up for mx4b-int4 tomorrow. focus: promptset curation for code-mixed locales and formatting-edgecases. need golden + review pool.
pete: Suggest golden=550, review=1450. keep ~150 existing anchors but mostly fresh long-tail.
mina: For dedupe: run exact token first (threshold 0.94), then semantic (embed tok-v2 cos>=0.83). preserve intent variants.
aria: Add adversarial formatting set (150) — malformed json, tables, inline code + markdown edgecases. Those caused parsing errors on last int4 run.
labelops-bot: LabelOps capacity: 1.6k/day with double-review. Reserve slots requested.
zara: Workflow: sample 2k focused -> normalize (nfkc + collapse ws) -> dedupe -> split 550 golden, 1450 review -> flag synthetics -> double review for golden -> adjudicate. timeline: start 08:30 UTC, 72h.
pete: Also include 80 long sequences (>1200 tokens) to stress kv cache. record tokenization variants (bpe/unigram) in exports.
mina: sampling config quick:
```
mode: focused
locales: ["en-IN","pt_BR","ko","tr","ru"]
min_tokens: 25
max_tokens: 1800
semantic_dedupe: 0.83
exact_dedupe: 0.94
adversarial_count: 150
long_seq_count: 80
golden_count: 550
labelpool_count: 1450
exclude_lists: ["holdout_main_2025","canary_mx4b_seed"]
```
aria: I'll stage seeds to s3://curation/mx4b/edgecases-2025 and add provenance JSON.
labelops-bot: Golden policy: double-review; adjudicate if disagreement>=17%; escalate to zara if >=30%. Slots reserved starting 08:30 UTC.
zara: can someone wire a lightweight harness to run crit-rate + tokenizer-delta + exact-match vs mx4b-fp16 and mx4b-int8? want per-locale deltas.
pete: I'll queue a smoke job and post results here within 12h of canary. snippet: `./eval/run --models mx4b-fp16,mx4b-int8,mx4b-int4 --dataset s3://curation/mx4b/micro-golden.json --metrics crit_rate,exact_match,tokenizer_delta`
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-06-21T09:00:00Z -> mx4b-int4 on staging-dedicated. Notifying #eng-runtime.
mina: final checklist: seeds uploaded, normalization run, dedupe lists, labelops reserved, harness queued, canary scheduled. no objections -> proceed.
zara: thanks all — will post final promptset link after upload. :rocket:
